name: standing isometric shoulder external rotation with towel
description: Press the back of your hand into a towel on a wall while standing. It trains the rotator cuff without moving the joint.
instructions: Stand next to a wall with a towel between the back of your hand and the wall.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees, tucked at your side.
Press your hand outward into the towel.
Hold the effort for 10 to 20 seconds.
